primary_sources.title: Bonadonna et al. 30 years follow-up of randomised adjuvant CMF studies
primary_sources.design: Long-term follow-up of three randomised trials and one observational study

initial_trial.population: Operable node-positive breast cancer after radical mastectomy
initial_trial.comparison: 12 cycles adjuvant CMF versus no further systemic treatment

duration_trial.conclusion: No evidence of superiority of 12 cycles; do not claim formal equivalence without a prespecified equivalence design

iv_trial.comparison: 12 cycles IV CMF every 3 weeks versus no systemic treatment

applicability: Historical adjuvant evidence, not a contemporary personalised prognosis or metastatic efficacy estimate.
The initial 12-cycle CMF comparison is not an exact trial of current 6-cycle NCCP00377.
The every-3-week IV trial used 12 cycles, not the current NCCP00381 eight cycles.
Do not assign the IV3-week numerical results to IV28 NCCP00378.
Do not infer equivalence among oral, IV28 and IV21 schedules.
Keep numerical evidence in clinician knowledge, not patient prognosis panels.

exact_schedule_evidence_status.00377: Historical CMF family adjuvant evidence; qualify the initial trial duration mismatch. Separate duration comparison supports discussion of six-cycle strategy.
exact_schedule_evidence_status.00378: Current NCCP recommendation; no exact IV28 schedule comparative numerical estimate verified in this review.
exact_schedule_evidence_status.00381: Historical IV3-week adjuvant trial; explicitly disclose 12 versus current8 cycles and restricted population.

metastatic_status: NCCP lists metastatic indication for all three; no regimen-specific metastatic numerical outcome estimate verified here.
